name: X-Palm
description: Palmprint modality offers a privacy-preserving biometric solution, yet its deployment is hindered by the domain gap between controlled enrollment and unconstrained authentication. Existing datasets are largely restricted to controlled setups and fail to capture the compound variability of real-world environments. In this paper, we introduce X-Palm, a cross-domain dataset comprising 6,006 palm images from 103 individuals (206 hands).
